requirements.detail: Install the k8s-nim-operator chart from https://helm.ngc.nvidia.com/nvidia at >=3.1.0 and wait for nimcaches.apps.nvidia.com and nimservices.apps.nvidia.com before applying this sample. The k8s-nim-operator chart is not yet a Catalog entry on this branch, so this requirement names the chart and does not link a record.

Create the image pull Secret ngc-secret (NIMCache spec.source.ngc.pullSecret, NIMService spec.image.pullSecrets) in the sample's namespace before apply. The sample carries the name only, and no credential is held here.

Create the API key Secret ngc-api-secret (NIMCache spec.source.ngc.authSecret, NIMService spec.authSecret) in the sample's namespace before apply. The sample carries the name only, and no key or token is held here.

The NIMService reads its model from NIMCache riva-tts, which this sample file also defines. NIMCache riva-tts asks the operator to create a 50Gi ReadWriteOnce PersistentVolumeClaim with an empty storageClass, so the storage class is a destination choice. Nothing here checked that a destination can provide it.
The NIMService requests 1 GPU per pod as nvidia.com/gpu, with 1 replica. A destination needs that many allocatable GPUs of a kind the image supports, and nothing here checked one.
Every object in the sample is in the nim-service namespace. The sample ships no Namespace object, so the namespace must exist before apply.
spec.expose.router.gateway names the Gateway istio-gateway in namespace nemo and asks for GRPCRoute objects. The Gateway API and that Gateway must exist on the destination.
spec.expose.router.hostDomainName is demo.nvidia.example.com, an example domain. A destination supplies its own.
